title: Reports
description: Regulatory returns and operational reports to read on screen, print or download as CSV.

ctls-monthly.title: CTLS monthly inventory summary
ctls-monthly.description: The monthly reconciliation for Health Canada: plants, cultures, seed lots and harvested material with opening, additions, reductions and closing balances.

destruction-register.title: Destruction register
destruction-register.description: Every destruction with the unit, experiment, cultivar, date, reason and witness, ready for an inspector.

inventory-snapshot.title: Inventory snapshot
inventory-snapshot.description: Everything in inventory right now, grouped by type, growth stage, location and cultivar, with weights and seed counts.

state-at-date.title: Inventory state at a date
state-at-date.description: What the laboratory held at the end of a chosen day, rebuilt from each event’s effective date.

inventory-movement.title: Inventory movement ledger
inventory-movement.description: Additions (registrations, derivations, receipts) and reductions (destructions, shipments) over a period, with every other change.

transfer-log.title: Chain of custody: location transfers
transfer-log.description: Every move between locations with the operator, the time and whether the barcode was scanned.

experiment-summary.title: Experiment summary
experiment-summary.description: For each experiment: units in inventory, destroyed and shipped, by type, with the team and the timeline.

stage-history.title: Stage transition history
stage-history.description: Every change of growth stage across all units, with who recorded it and any comment.

activity-audit.title: Audit trail export
activity-audit.description: The audit trail for a period with field-level changes, for sharing outside the application.

locked.title: Reports are for administrators
locked.body: Reports show inventory quantities and the audit trail, so they stay with administrators. The dashboard and the compliance console show the live position to every member.

ctls.heading: Inventory reconciliation
ctls.flow: Closing = opening + additions − reductions (+ adjustments for weights and counts).
ctls.caption: Inventory reconciliation

notes.zone: Months are calendar months in the laboratory time zone ({zone}). Dates are the effective date of each event, not the date it was filed.
notes.opening: Opening balances are the units active at the very start of the month: their newest effective event is not a shipment or a destruction.
notes.additions: Additions are registrations and receipts effective in the month (new units, derived clones and subcultures, external receipts), each counted once.
notes.reductions: Reductions are shipments and destructions effective in the month.
notes.reconciled: Reconciled: on every unit-count line, closing = opening + additions − reductions.
notes.notReconciled: NOT RECONCILED: closing differs from opening + additions − reductions on at least one unit-count line. Investigate before filing.
notes.adjustments: Seed and weight lines also report adjustments: the net change from re-measurement during the month. Closing = opening + additions − reductions + adjustments.
notes.distribution: Vegetative, flowering and other-stage rows show how the closing plant count is distributed; plant flows are on the total row.

sectionDescriptions.additions-detail: Each unit that entered inventory during the period. Open a unit to see its live profile.
sectionDescriptions.destruction-records: The destruction date is when the material was destroyed; filed at is when the record was entered.
